interpretation: The smoke workflow contained no repository checkout, dependency installation, validator, or mathematical test.
Its failure before a reported step means the run cannot be used as evidence that repository source, HINC mathematics, validators, or tests failed.
The exact account, billing, policy, runner-allocation, or platform cause was not exposed by the available GitHub API response and is not asserted.
Private pre-release validation must therefore use the guarded local preflight until hosted execution becomes available.
The post-switch Pages workflow remains fail-closed and must run only after GitHub reports public repository visibility.
